cell.name: 3-5__critical
cell.pose_label: the traced pose with the smallest validity margin
cell.rationale: no internal reflection: the 22 deg halo path on the canonical column (tests/test_discovery.py's production scene); next to an interior extremum of D_P (a caustic): a short loop around a Jacobian-degenerate point

selection.method: lit side of an interior extremum of D_P

fresnel_transmission.basis: float64 evaluation of the same closed-form refraction/reflection chain from bit-identical JSON inputs: a few ulp per interface (1e-12 leaves ~1e3 ulp of room), times 1/(2 sqrt(d)) for the smallest Snell discriminant d of the pose, the derivative of the refracted cosine sqrt(d) (kinematic_atol)
